messages.subject: round_any on Date objects
parts:
Hi,

I would like to group observations for a boxplot with round_any(), but
it turns out that no method is defined for Date objects (I would like
to group daily observations in weekly of monthly bins). Any
suggestion on which functions/packages I could use? Many thanks in
advance.

Kind regards,
Ivan

messages.subject: Re: round_any on Date objects

Sorry - hit sent too soon.

You should be able to implement round_date by modifying ceiling_date.
You can use the functions like:

floor_date(mydate, "5 day")
floor_date(mydate, "2 week")
floor_date(mydate, "month")

etc.

But I should make round_any generic - I'll add that to my to do.

Hadley
